entities.title: Cloudflare Web Analytics
entities.summary: Page views reported by Cloudflare's beacon, which Cloudflare injects into the page.
entities.meaning: Visits to the game's page and its scores page.
excludes: Anything inside the game: games, scores and names are not reported.
entities.details: The page's and the scores page's content security policies allow the beacon's script and reports; nothing in this folder emits them. The Worker writes no logs or metrics of its own: an unexpected error in the API becomes a 500 with { error: "server error" } and is not recorded.

entities.title: Play time (the games hub's play.js)
entities.summary: The page loads the games hub's /games/play.js, tagged data-game="hivestorm".
entities.meaning: The games hub's record of play in Hivestorm. What it records, and where, is the hub's and was not checked here.
